info.name: SIRMS - Service 3 - Incident Management (Karim Hajj Ali)
info.description: Incident Management Service for the Security Incident Detection and Response Management System. Implemented by Karim Hajj Ali. Run the Authentication folder first to populate the tokens.

item.name: 0. Authentication (run first)
item.description: Logs in as each role and saves the tokens. Authentication belongs to Service 1 and is included here only so this collection can be run on its own.
